summary.text: Francis Awerkamp is a Republican state representative from Kansas House District 61 who has represented the district since January 2017 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Francis Awerkamp took office in the Kansas House of Representatives on January 9, 2017.
In the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Energy, Utilities, and Telecommunications and Taxation committees and chairs the Welfare Reform Committee.
